snippet.title: Budgie's Bug Shop // Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/4279120/Budgies_Bug_Shop

A short incremental game about catching bugs and running a shop filled with parakeets. Upgrade equipment, purchase game-breaking abilities, and maximize the profits of your Budgie-powered empire!

Developed by
Moon Lagoon
